title: Clathrin 晶格/被覆装配
species_selection: 按组织、适配蛋白和实验体系选择；6WCJ 只是牛来源局部 cage 顶点

asset_candidates.use_and_limits: clathrin minicoat 非对称顶点结构
asset_candidates.access_level: entry/metadata inspected; coordinates not imported for this storyboard

asset_candidates.use_and_limits: D6 coat C-alpha model. Deposited assembly1 contains36 modeled triskelia; heavy chains1-1630 and light-chain segments95-164. Unresolved regions are not complete proteins. Bovine source, distinct from the porcine-clathrin AP2 membrane reconstitution.
asset_candidates.access_level: Coordinates and assembly1 downloaded;216 chains and183600 sites inspected,12 source operators available. No complete coat animation implemented by this storyboard.

asset_candidates.use_and_limits: Local clathrin fragments with one AP2 beta2 appendage; not a whole cage or full AP2 molecule. The flexible core-to-appendage hinge is unresolved.
asset_candidates.access_level: Coordinates and primary methods inspected; full-actor reconstruction pending.

actors: 完整 triskelion 的重/轻链

stages.action: 展示货物、适配蛋白与胞质侧膜面
完整 triskelion 在邻接位点形成局部网格
按证据支持的几何扩展被覆窝和曲率
出芽、颈切断、脱被覆拆成后续阶段，分别选择所需因子

geometry_plan: 局部 cage 顶点不等于完整 triskelion，要补足来源再实例化
保留多边形网格和腿部连接，不能简单复制正六边形球壳代替所有 cage
膜拓扑与被覆装配采用独立但耦合的事件表
camera_plan: 先从胞质侧看组装，再切换侧视观察膜颈
内视图移走完整 triskelion，不直接截断分子腿
acceptance: 被覆始终在胞质侧，货物胞内外域不翻转
封闭 cage 不自动等于膜已经切断
裂解前后保留膜腔连通性记录
limitations: clathrin 形状本身不能证明受体密度、曲率形成途径或 dynamin 作用步骤
